name: framer-normal-carousel
blurb: Simple full-width image carousel with previous/next navigation buttons.
description: Basic image carousel displaying one full-width image per slide. Navigate with prev/next buttons. Uses spring physics for smooth snap animation between slides.
use_when: Simple image galleries or hero sections with straightforward navigation.
avoid_when: When complex interactions or multiple visible slides are needed.
a11y: Previous/next buttons provide navigation; keyboard support depends on button implementation.
